quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the importance of seeking knowledge
quotes.excerpt: You got to ask for knowledge. That's the most important thing.
quotes.quote: You got to ask for knowledge. That's the most important thing. Hey, what it took to make it to the NBA? When I get to the NBA, what I got to do? What's the approach I got to have with my teammates? With my coach? How do you deal with 20,000 fans? How do you deal with pressure? How do you deal with the fame? How do you deal with distractions? You got to ask for the knowledge.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on learning from Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: The only picture I got is with Kobe Bryant. But like, when I went there, I had a notebook.
quotes.quote: The only picture I got is with Kobe Bryant. But like, when I went there, I had a notebook. I had a notebook and I asked him like 50 questions. I got that notebook right here in my house. Whenever I get confused, whenever I don't have the answer, I go back to that notebook. I'm like, okay, what did he say here? I have that knowledge in a notebook.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his journey to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I wasn't a top player. I wasn't a top pick. I wasn't rookie of the year.
quotes.quote: It doesn't matter what you're regarded. If you're the top player in the country, top player in sixth grade, or top player in college, it does not matter. I wasn't a top player. I wasn't a top pick. I wasn't rookie of the year. I wasn't all of that. But I'll tell you one thing, I'm top 20 of all-time. It's about the journey. How can you get better every single day?

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the necessity of hard work
quotes.excerpt: It's all about hard work. You cannot cheat. You cannot cheat the system.
quotes.quote: It's all about hard work. You cannot cheat. You cannot cheat the system. You can't cheat the journey. If you don't work hard, it won't happen. If you work hard, it will happen. If you believe and you work, it will happen. I promise you. That does not matter where you start. You can't compare one another. Everybody has different journeys. Just focus on what you do. Focus on your own journey.
